scope: Independent read-only re-review of Jev adapter deadline finding only; no live provider calls or shared full build

originalFinding.issue: SDK timeout aborts the signal but still awaits transport or body read. An abort-ignoring transport or stalled stream could hang choose indefinitely; the original timeout test cooperated with abort.

evidence: jev-client.ts:193-225 adds an adapter-owned timer and races the SDK call against a controller-abort rejection; abort and deadline both return sanitized UNKNOWN after dispatch.
jev-client.ts:132-150 no longer awaits potentially stalled body cancellation, and abort requests cancellation of a stalled reader.
jev-client.test.ts:138-164 tests an abort-ignoring pending fetch and stalled response stream with one call and bounded wall time.
repairAssessment.residualLimit: An injected transport that ignores abort can remain pending after choose returns UNKNOWN; the adapter cannot terminate arbitrary transport work. This does not prevent the bounded caller result and must not authorize a retry.
repairAssessment.validationClaim: Builder reported focused typecheck and 15 tests passing; this review inspected exact source and tests but did not rerun those checks.
